name: Algorithm Baiting (Greedy/MST)
description: Rephrased the problem using "groups" and "MERGE operations" to closely mimic the standard textbook description of Disjoint Set Union and Kruskal's algorithm. By using vocabulary strongly associated with Minimum Spanning Trees, this actively baits the model into applying a greedy edge-sorting approach, distracting it from the underlying Steiner Tree structure that requires subset dynamic programming.
